items.source:
Long polling-based transports (for example, "xhr", "jsonp") complete the request
after writing the open frame. Streaming-based transports ("xhr_streaming",
"eventsource", and "htmlfile") leave the response open longer for further
streaming of message frames but will also close it eventually after some
amount of data has been sent.
items.translation: 基于长轮询的传输方式（例如，"xhr"、"jsonp"）在完成 open frame 写入后结束请求。基于流式的传输方式（"xhr_streaming"、"eventsource" 和 "htmlfile"）会保持响应打开更长时间以进一步流式传输消息帧，但也会在发送一定量的数据后最终关闭它。

items.source:
Long polling-based transports (for example, "xhr", "jsonp") complete the request
after writing any buffered message frames (or the next one). Streaming-based
transports ("xhr_streaming", "eventsource", and "htmlfile") leave the
response open longer for further streaming of message frames but will also
close it eventually after some amount of data has been sent.
items.translation: 基于长轮询的传输方式（例如，"xhr"、"jsonp"）在写入任何缓冲的消息帧（或下一个）后完成请求。基于流式的传输方式（"xhr_streaming"、"eventsource" 和 "htmlfile"）会保持响应打开更长时间以进一步流式传输消息帧，但也会在发送一定量的数据后最终关闭它。

items.source:
Unlike WebSocket where sub-protocol negotiation is part of the initial
handshake, in HTTP transports the same negotiation must be emulated and
the selected protocol set through this setter.
items.translation: 与 WebSocket 不同，子协议协商是初始握手的一部分；而在 HTTP 传输中，必须模拟相同的协商过程，并通过此 Setter 设置所选协议。

items.source:
Return the SockJS buffer for messages stored transparently between polling
requests. If the polling request takes longer than 5 seconds, the session
is closed.
items.translation: 返回在轮询请求之间透明存储消息的 SockJS 缓冲区。如果轮询请求耗时超过 5 秒，则关闭会话。

items.source:
Polling and Streaming sessions periodically close the current HTTP request and
wait for the next request to come through. During this "downtime" the session is
still open but inactive and unable to send messages and therefore has to buffer
them temporarily. A WebSocket session by contrast is stateful and remain active
until closed.
items.translation: 轮询和流式传输会话会定期关闭当前的 HTTP 请求并等待下一个请求的到来。在此期间，“停机”时间内，会话仍然处于打开状态但不活动，无法发送消息，因此必须暂时缓冲这些消息。相比之下，WebSocket 会话是有状态的，并在关闭前保持活动状态。

items.source:
Called when the connection is active and ready to write to the response.
Subclasses should only call this method from a method where the

items.translation: 在连接处于活动状态且已准备好向响应写入时调用。子类应仅在获取了"responseLock"的方法中调用此方法。
